title: Joshua Chosen as Moses' Successor
description: Moses announces that he will not lead the people across the Jordan and appoints Joshua as his successor, urging him to be strong and courageous. After Moses' death, the Lord speaks directly to Joshua and confirms the call to lead the people into the promised land.

versions.title: Joshua Chosen as Moses' Successor
versions.description: After Moses learns that he will not lead the people into the promised land, God appoints Joshua as his successor and commands him to be strong and courageous.
versions.reason: [minor] references: The proposal combines two distinct narrative moments (the installation in Deut 31 and the Lord's call in Josh 1) which are connected but could also be treated separately. It functions as one continuous story about Joshua's appointment.
